subject: Today: Running R on cloud server through Amazon (for free!)

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Today: Running R on cloud server through Amazon (for free!)
parts:
Hi all,

A reminder that today at D-RUG I'll be talking about how to set up a free cloud server through Amazon Web Services and run R and RStudio on it.  If you want to follow along, please set up an AWS account ahead of time at http://aws.amazon.com/.  (Amazon will ask for your credit card, but we won't be doing anything that costs money).

See you at the regular time and place: 1:10-3pm today in Wickson 2124

Cheers,

Noam
